tools.name: insightly_get_current_user
tools.description: Fetch the user the API key belongs to (USER_ID, name, email, admin flag). A cheap way to confirm the key and pod are right, and to get your own id for owner fields. Insightly: GET /Users/Me.

tools.name: insightly_list_users
tools.description: List the users in the Insightly instance — needed to resolve OWNER_USER_ID / RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID. Insightly: GET /Users.

tools.name: insightly_list_records
tools.description: List records of one type — Contacts, Organisations, Leads, Opportunities, Projects, Tasks, Events or Notes — optionally filtered by one field value and/or last-updated time. With field_name + field_value (both required together) or updated_after_utc this uses GET /<Object>/Search; otherwise GET /<Ob

tools.name: insightly_get_record
tools.description: Fetch a single Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity, Project, Task, Event or Note by id, with its custom fields, tags and links. Insightly: GET /<Object>/{id}.

tools.name: insightly_list_record_activity
tools.description: List the Notes, Tasks or Events attached to one Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity or Project — the activity history of that record. Insightly: GET /<Object>/{id}/Notes | Tasks | Events.

tools.name: insightly_search_by_tag
tools.description: List Contacts, Organisations, Leads, Opportunities or Projects carrying a tag. Insightly: GET /<Object>/SearchByTag?tagName=.

tools.name: insightly_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales and project pipelines (PIPELINE_ID, name, whether for opportunities or projects). Insightly: GET /Pipelines.

tools.name: insightly_list_pipeline_stages
tools.description: List every pipeline stage (STAGE_ID, PIPELINE_ID, name, order) — map an opportunity's or project's STAGE_ID to a stage name. Insightly: GET /PipelineStages.

tools.name: insightly_list_lead_statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses defined in the instance (LEAD_STATUS_ID, name, type). Insightly: GET /LeadStatuses.

tools.name: insightly_list_lead_sources
tools.description: List the lead sources defined in the instance (LEAD_SOURCE_ID, name). Insightly: GET /LeadSources.

tools.name: insightly_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact (first_name is required). Insightly: POST /Contacts.

tools.name: insightly_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact. Only the fields you pass are changed (v3.1 partial update). Insightly: PUT /Contacts with CONTACT_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_organisation
tools.description: Create an organisation (company). Insightly: POST /Organisations.

tools.name: insightly_update_organisation
tools.description: Update an organisation. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Organisations with ORGANISATION_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead (last_name is required). Insightly's schema also marks lead_status_id and lead_source_id as required — get valid ids from insightly_list_lead_statuses / insightly_list_lead_sources. Insightly: POST /Leads.

tools.name: insightly_update_lead
tools.description: Update a lead. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Leads with LEAD_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity (opportunity_name is required). Insightly: POST /Opportunities.

tools.name: insightly_update_opportunity
tools.description: Update an opportunity's value, probability, dates, owner or details. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Opportunities with OPPORTUNITY_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_task
tools.description: Create a task (title is required). Insightly requires OWNER_USER_ID and COMPLETED on a task: if owner_user_id is omitted it is filled with the API key's own user (via GET /Users/Me), and completed defaults to false. Insightly: POST /Tasks.

tools.name: insightly_update_task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it completed, change due date, status, assignee or details. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Tasks with TASK_ID.

tools.name: insightly_add_note
tools.description: Add a note (title + body) to a Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity or Project. Insightly: POST /<Object>/{id}/Notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_create_lead, insightly_create_task · Private data: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_list_records, insightly_get_record, insightly_list_record_activity, insightly_search_by_tag, insightly_create_contact, insightly_update_contact, insightly_create_task, insightly_add_note · Public sink: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_create_contact, insightly_create_organisation, insightly_create_lead, insightly_create_opportunity, insightly_create_task, insightly_add_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_create_lead, insightly_create_task · Private data: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_list_records, insightly_get_record, insightly_list_record_activity, insightly_search_by_tag, insightly_create_contact, insightly_update_contact, insightly_create_task, insightly_add_note · Public sink: insightly_get_current_user, insightly_create_contact, insightly_create_organisation, insightly_create_lead, insightly_create_opportunity, insightly_create_task, insightly_add_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
